name: Orange-Water Ice
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of boiling water

ingredients.name: the strained juice of six oranges
ingredients.originalText: the strained juice of six oranges

instructions.text: Add a tablespoonful of gelatine to one gill of water and let it stand twenty minutes
Add half a pint of boiling water and stir until dissolved
Add four ounces of powdered sugar, the strained juice of six oranges and cold water enough to make a full quart in all
Stir until the sugar is dissolved
Pour into the freezing can and freeze

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Add a tablespoonful of gelatine to one gill of water and let it stand twenty minutes
2. Add half a pint of boiling water and stir until dissolved
3. Add four ounces of powdered sugar, the strained juice of six oranges and cold water enough to make a full quart in all
4. Stir until the sugar is dissolved
5. Pour into the freezing can and freeze

the strained juice of six oranges
